app.name: Masar
app.tagline: Every lead has a follow-up. Every follow-up has a time.

auth.description: Keep real estate follow-up organized, from first contact through close.
auth.sendLink: We will send you a confirmation link to finish signing up.
auth.supabaseMissing: Add Supabase credentials to your environment to enable sign-in.

organization.setupDescription: Set up your sales workspace and local business hours.
organization.name: Organization name
organization.webhookDescription: Connect a form or campaign. Every lead is assigned and given a follow-up task automatically.
organization.webhookError: Could not create the secret. Check your organization role.
organization.webhookRevealOnce: Copy this secret and store it now. It will not be shown again.
organization.webhookBody: Send a JSON POST with name and phone. email, source, and property_interest are optional.
organization.webhookRotationWarning: Rotating the secret immediately invalidates the previous one.
organization.workflowDescription: One focused rule: balanced assignment, a required follow-up, then reminder and escalation.
organization.autoAssignHelp: Leads rotate across active sales members, starting with the longest-waiting member.
organization.noSalesMembers: There are no sales members in this organization yet.
organization.noActiveSales: Without an active salesperson, the lead waits for the next workday and keeps its follow-up.
organization.workingMinutesHelp: Deadlines count organization working hours and days only.

dashboard.importDescription: Upload a CSV or Excel file, review the column mapping, then import valid rows.
dashboard.importFileLabel: CSV or XLSX file, up to 5 MB and 500 rows
dashboard.importResult: Added {created}, skipped {duplicates} duplicates, and could not import {failed}.
dashboard.importForbidden: Only organization managers and owners can import lists.
dashboard.importFileTooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB.
dashboard.importUnsupportedFile: Supported formats are CSV and XLSX.
dashboard.importEmptyFile: No header and data rows were found in the file.
dashboard.importTooManyRows: Imports are limited to 500 rows at a time.
dashboard.importInvalidFile: We could not read this file. Check its format and try again.
dashboard.importFailed: The import could not be completed. Try again.
dashboard.duplicateLead: This phone number is already on file. No second copy was added.
dashboard.emptyLeadsDescription: Add the lead details and we’ll assign an owner and set a follow-up time.
dashboard.emptyTasksDescription: Every new lead gets a follow-up time automatically.
dashboard.reminderEmpty: Nothing needs your attention right now.

messages.genericError: Could not complete the request. Check the details and try again.
messages.authError: The email address or password is incorrect.
messages.accountCreated: Account created. Check your email to confirm it.
